description: This source file implements the core logic for CUJO agent security functionalities, including initialization, event handling, management of socket communication, web configuration processing, and the interaction with WiFi station and radio events. It defines the main callback routines for various WiFi management frames, web configuration updates, and maintains thread-safe queues and synchronization primitives for inter-thread communication.

classes.description: Main data structure representing state and resources for managing WiFi consumer events, queues, socket descriptors, epoll instances, and synchronization primitives.

classes.description: Structure used for passing WiFi-related events (webconfig, station updates, mgmt frames) between threads via queue.
